name: AI Agent DevContainer
postStartCommand: bash -c 'init-ai-devcontainer-home && (git lfs uninstall || true) && if [ "$OPENCODE_CONFIG" = /home/codespace/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc ] && [ -f /home/codespace/.config/opencode/untracked-config.jsonc ]; then export OPENCODE_CONFIG=/home/codespace/.config/opencode/untracked-config.jsonc; fi && echo OpenCode starting on port ${OPENCODE_PORT:-4096}... && cd /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename} && (nc -z localhost ${OPENCODE_PORT:-4096} >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo already running || opencode serve --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${OPENCODE_PORT:-4096})'
